items.q: What core services does SoftBuild provide?
items.a: We specialize in providing digital transformation solutions from website design, apps, specialized software to AI development. In addition, SoftBuild also develops an IoT smart device system and a Blockchain decentralized database with absolute security. With these services, we confidently accompany businesses in each stage of development.

items.q: What is the biggest difference when collaborating with SoftBuild?
items.a: SoftBuild's core differentiator is the close combination of business thinking and technical capabilities. Instead of simply outsourcing software, we focus on accurately solving business problems to optimize costs and improve conversion rates. To accomplish this, SoftBuild possesses a team of experienced multinational experts capable of handling complex systems. At the same time, we continuously update and apply the latest technologies to ensure the product is always secure, operates stably and easily expands according to business growth.

items.q: How do I track project progress?
items.a: We value transparency. Customers will be given access to project management tools, participate in regular progress reporting meetings, and experience the product firsthand at each stage of completion.

items.q: How is the cost for a project calculated?
items.a: Costs are based on project size, complexity, and implementation time. After the initial consultation, SoftBuild will provide a detailed quote. We have diverse cooperation models from packages for projects with clear requirements, or more flexible packages for long-term projects that need flexibility to change.

items.q: Once completed, who owns the source code and data?
items.a: Are our customers. Immediately after the project is accepted and payment is completed, all intellectual property rights, application copyright and 100% of the source code will be handed over to your business.

items.q: How does SoftBuild keep my information and business ideas secure?
items.a: Security is a top priority. We always sign an Information Confidentiality Agreement with customers right from the initial consultation stage, before both parties share important data or ideas.

items.q: After the product launch, will SoftBuild continue to support it?
items.a: Yes. All products developed by SoftBuild come with a free warranty period, usually from 3 to 6 months, to handle arising errors.

items.q: What if I want to upgrade or add new features later?
items.a: Our system is always built with an open architecture, easy to expand. Customers can sign additional maintenance and operation packages or feature upgrade contracts at preferential prices exclusively for old customers.
